text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see... So Umamusume families share<n>and pass
down their assets and<n>knowledge among their
members. In<n>order to learn more about their
strength...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I talk to Daiichi Ruby from the most<n>prestigious of
households! She tells<n>me that she and her family
are one<n>and the same.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
With their incredible sense of unity<n>backed up by
wealth and knowledge,<n>it's no wonder they're
strong. But I<n>can't just sit back and watch those
who were set up for success do all<n>the winning!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You aren't limited to only forming<n>bonds with
people in your family! My<n>trainer and I will show
that bonds can<n>be formed with anyone!
